title: pygeum ceylanicum
intro: Pygeum ceylanicum, commonly known as Prune of Ceylon, is a plant native to Sri Lanka and other parts of Asia, belonging to the genus Prunus. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as reducing symptoms of benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH) and improving urinary flow. The therapeutic actions of Pygeum ceylanicum include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may contribute to its potential in managing BPH and other related conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
